player_prompt.intro:
Aweyi kpɛndɛɛlɛ {player_id} le kpɛlɛyɛ sɔsɔɔ {num_rounds} IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Kpɛlɛyɛ kʋnɛyɛ, tɛmɛ kpɛlɛɛlɛ sɔsɔɔ {min_guess} nɛ {max_guess}.
Kpɛlɛɛlɛ pɛɛyɛ, tɛmɛɛlɛɛ sɔsɔɔ (2/3)x(kpɛlɛɛlɛ pɛɛyɛ pɛɛyɛ),
nɛ kpɛndɛɛlɛ sɔsɔɔ tɛmɛɛlɛɛ sɔsɔɔ tɛmɛɛlɛɛ.
Kpɛlɛɛlɛɛ wɛɛlɛɛ '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Pɩtɛ matʋ fɛyɩ ɖeu; ɖɩpɔzʋʋ-mɩ se ɩlɩzɩ mɩ-tɔm mayaɣ [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pɩwɛɛ se ɛmaɣzɩ nɛ ɛna yɔ, pɩwɛ {min_guess} nɛ {max_guess} pɛ-hɛkʋ taa.

message.round_guesses: Piloto 0 ŋɔŋa {guess0}; Piloto 1 ŋɔŋa {guess1}. Kɛɛbɛ lɛ, Tɛmɛlɩyɛ kɛɛkɛɛ: {target}.
